description: This 20-Jar Rotating Spice Organizer keeps spices within easy reach while saving valuable counter space. It is an indispensable choice for home and the favorite of gourmets. If you want to say goodbye to the chaotic spices, you only need this spice rack! The rotating stainless steel spice rack holds 20 jars empty. Jars feature sifter tops for a light seasoning that remove for measuring. It's very nice looking and can fit well on your counter’s corner. We employ a lead-free and eco-friendly glass bottle body matched with a stainless steel bottle cap, which has good performance in dust and moisture prevention. We have prepared custom labels for you, so you only need to put in your own condiments and mark them according to your habits. It is a good helper in cooking no matter at home, commercial kitchen or hotel restaurants.
